officialLinks.label: GPA calculation; exact quality points; rounding

helpIntro: Dartmouth undergraduate GPA uses a 4.0 scale with exact thirds for plus/minus grades. Enter each GPA-bearing Dartmouth course as 1 course; E counts at zero, while CT, NC and NR do not enter the recorded GPA.
helpNote: For Arts & Sciences undergraduates. The calculator displays three decimals for planning; Dartmouth calculates internally to high precision and rounds the official GPA to two decimals. Graduate grading is separate. Repeat Impact is unavailable because Dartmouth does not use simple grade replacement.
helpExample: Three courses with A, B+, and B- produce (4 + 3⅓ + 2⅔) ÷ 3 = 3.333…, which Dartmouth reports as 3.33.

gradeExplanations.A: A = 4.0; Dartmouth uses 12 quality points before dividing by 3.
gradeExplanations.A-: A- = 11/3 = 3.666…; official GPA math uses exact thirds.
gradeExplanations.B+: B+ = 10/3 = 3.333…; official GPA math uses exact thirds.
gradeExplanations.D: D = 1.0 and earns course credit subject to degree limits.
gradeExplanations.E: E = 0.0; it is included in GPA and earns no course credit.
gradeExplanations.CT: Credit in a Credit/No Credit course; excluded from cumulative GPA.
gradeExplanations.NC: No Credit in a Credit/No Credit course; excluded from Dartmouth GPA.
gradeExplanations.NR: Non-Recorded standing; concealed letter grade is excluded from recorded GPA unless the outcome is E.
gradeExplanations.I: Temporary Incomplete notation; wait for the final grade.
gradeExplanations.ON: Temporary On-Going designation; wait for the final grade.
gradeExplanations.AD: Temporary Administrative Delay designation; wait for the final grade.

specialTypes.name: Dartmouth A-E course
specialTypes.note: Enter 1 course for a standard GPA-bearing Dartmouth course and its final A-E grade.

specialTypes.name: Credit/No Credit course
specialTypes.note: Use CT or NC; both are excluded from Dartmouth cumulative GPA.

specialTypes.name: Non-Recording Option outcome
specialTypes.note: Use NR when the grade is non-recorded; if the outcome is E, enter E because Dartmouth includes it in GPA.

specialTypes.name: External transfer or exchange credit
specialTypes.note: Grades transferred from another institution are not included in Dartmouth cumulative GPA.

repeatPolicy.note: For a repeated failed course, enter both graded attempts as separate completed rows. Do not use the repeat tool; passed-course retakes can be non-averaged and need Registrar review.
